title: csoai.signed-release-manifest/0.1
description: One release, exact bytes, declared signer authority, mirror readbacks, and explicit proof states. A manifest is evidence about a release process, never a certification. Three-state verification throughout: VALID / INVALID(reason) / UNCHECKABLE. Absence of a proof is a first-class state, not a zero.

dirty_tree.description: was the working tree dirty at build time; a dirty build is allowed but must be declared

build_runner.description: e.g. gha-run-id, local hostname-free label; never secrets

files.description: exact released bytes. Hashing rule is versioned and declared once here, never silently migrated.

authority_doc.description: URL or repo path documenting WHY this key may sign releases, plus rotation/compromise procedure

preimage_rule.description: exact byte rule the signature covers, e.g. 'Ed25519 over raw UTF-8 of canonical JSON of this manifest minus signature fields, keys sorted recursively, no whitespace, ensure_ascii=false'

signature_state.description: UNSIGNED_DECLARED is a first-class honest state (e.g. rehearsal), never a fabricated signature

timestamp_proofs.description: existence-before evidence bound to EXACT bytes of this manifest. A pending stamp stays pending. A log entry never proves semantic truth, authorship beyond the bound identity, compliance, or current validity.

binds_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact manifest bytes the proof covers

block_or_log_ref.description: e.g. Bitcoin block height or Rekor log index; only when CONFIRMED

mirrors.description: publication is only real with anonymous readback. Listing/submission is not acceptance; HTTP 200 is not correct bytes.

readback_sha256.description: sha256 of bytes fetched anonymously; must equal the corresponding files entry for PUBLISHED_READBACK_VERIFIED

verifier.description: tool + version that re-hashed the files
